text.en: Artists in Canada have done fine work for a very long time, and Canadians are proud of it.
text.fr: Les artistes du Canada font de belles œuvres depuis très longtemps, et les Canadiens en sont fiers.

source.quote: Canadian artists have a long history of achievement in which Canadians take pride.

text.en: Artists from every region show what Canadian culture is and help shape the ways people create. Their work has been outstanding at home and in other countries.
text.fr: Des artistes de toutes les régions montrent ce qu'est la culture canadienne et façonnent les formes de création. Leur travail est remarquable au pays comme à l'étranger.

source.quote: Artists from all regions reflect and define our culture and forms of creative expression and have achieved greatness both at home and abroad.

text.en: Canadian writers have added a great deal to literature in both English and French.
text.fr: Les écrivains canadiens ont beaucoup apporté à la littérature en anglais comme en français.

source.quote: Canadians have made significant contributions to literature in English and in French.

text.en: Novel writers, poets, historians, teachers and musicians have all left a deep mark on the country's culture.
text.fr: Les romanciers, les poètes, les historiens, les enseignants et les musiciens ont tous laissé une marque profonde sur la culture du pays.

source.quote: Novelists, poets, historians, educators and musicians have had a significant cultural impact.

text.en: Canada's writers have included Pauline Johnson, Mordecai Richler, Stephen Leacock, Émile Nelligan, Margaret Laurence, Louis Hémon, Robertson Davies and Sir Charles G.D. Roberts.
text.fr: Parmi les écrivains du Canada, on compte Pauline Johnson, Mordecai Richler, Stephen Leacock, Émile Nelligan, Margaret Laurence, Louis Hémon, Robertson Davies et Sir Charles G.D. Roberts.

source.quote: Men and women of letters included Stephen Leacock, Louis Hémon, Sir Charles G.D. Roberts, Pauline Johnson, Émile Nelligan, Robertson Davies, Margaret Laurence and Mordecai Richler.

text.en: Two musicians, Healey Willan and Sir Ernest MacMillan, became well known in Canada and in other countries.
text.fr: Deux musiciens, Healey Willan et Sir Ernest MacMillan, se sont fait connaître au Canada comme à l'étranger.

source.quote: Musicians such as Sir Ernest MacMillan and Healey Willan won renown in Canada and abroad.

text.en: Rohinton Mistry, Michael Ondaatje and Joy Kogawa have widened the range of writing in Canada.
text.fr: Rohinton Mistry, Michael Ondaatje et Joy Kogawa ont élargi l'éventail de la littérature au Canada.

source.quote: Writers such as Joy Kogawa, Michael Ondaatje and Rohinton Mistry have diversified Canada’s literary experience.

text.en: Louis-Philippe Hébert, from Quebec, was a well-known sculptor. He made statues of figures from history.
text.fr: Louis-Philippe Hébert, du Québec, était un sculpteur renommé. Il a sculpté des personnages de l'histoire.

source.quote: Quebec’s Louis-Philippe Hébert was a celebrated sculptor of historical figures.
